verses.1: The older man was chosen as a leader, along with his sons. I truly love them all. It wasn’t just me who loved them; everyone who knew the truth also loved them.
verses.2: Because the truth remains with us, and it will remain with us throughout the ages.
verses.3: It will be a gift from us, along with mercy and peace from God the Father. And from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.4: I was glad to find that you truly traveled among your sons, as we are commanded to do by our father.
verses.5: And now, I ask you, my lady, not as a new command to be written down, but as something we have always had since the beginning: that we may love each other.
verses.6: And this is love—to follow His commands. This commandment is, as you have heard from the beginning, to follow it.
verses.7: For many people have come into the world without admitting that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is precisely what is meant by “falsity” and “falsehood”.
verses.8: See yourselves that you do not fail to complete what we have assigned to you. Instead, you will receive full payment for your work.
verses.9: Anyone who does not stay in the teachings of Christ does not have God. But those who do stay in these teachings, they have both the Father and the Son.
verses.10: If anyone comes to you and tries to teach you this, do not let them enter your home. Do not allow them to be a part of your life or to share your joy with you.
verses.11: For he said to him, “Rejoice together with those who do evil.”
verses.12: I didn’t want to write to you in a formal manner, using complicated words and expressions. I hope that we can speak face-to-face, so that your happiness can be truly fulfilled.
verses.13: Protect your sister’s children from those who are against her.
